shortDescription: Clones an uploaded virtual disk and attaches it to a virtual machine.

options.name: disk
options.description: The disk that will be created when selected virtual disk is attached to selected virtual machine.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual disk that we want to attach. Used as a unique identifier of an uploaded virtual disk.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Virtual machine name. Used to identify selected virtual machine by name.
